listing.name: Shadow Tower — reshadowtower (JFryy)
listing.summary: Experimental project. Experimental mouse/WASD/rendering title work; interpreter fallback remains, not every path native. These are the project’s reports; See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS-00863 BIN/CUE. OpenBIOS is supplied. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the advertised AppImage or installer to generate and compile locally from your own disc with the bundled tools. Alternatively, follow scripts/build.sh and run.sh for a source build. Portcove does not manage this download and has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

warnings: This experimental runtime develops mouse input, WASD controls and rendering. Interpreter fallback remains; some execution paths are not native. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
